subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II confirmation + targeted auth-control pack
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novushealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novushealth.com
Date: Sun, 09 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II confirmation + targeted artifacts (auth controls)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our information security intake for the pilot, we need to confirm Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II coverage and collect a small set of targeted artifacts related to authentication and access controls. To be explicit, our security team is requesting: 

- A copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month period) or a bridge letter if the report period doesn't cover our requested window.
- An auth-control pack containing: MFA enforcement policy (policy excerpt), a 30-day authentication log slice (time range: 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-31) showing successful/failed MFA events (redact PII), and the latest privileged access review summary for admin roles.
- Clarification on retention for auth logs (where they live, retention period, and whether log extracts include source IP and device id).

We aim to complete our intake by 2025-11-20. Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimate for delivery? If there are any export templates or minimum fields you need to include in the log slice, please let us know.

I've attached a short request form for internal tracking.

Thanks,
Elena
Security Lead, Novus Health

Attachments: soc2-request-form-novus.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II confirmation + targeted artifacts (auth controls)

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. Short answer: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II report (redacted public copy) and targeted auth artifacts, but a couple of quick clarifications so we scope the log slice correctly: 

1) For the auth log slice you requested (2025-10-01 to 2025-10-31): do you need per-event device identifiers (e.g., device fingerprint) in addition to source IPs? Including device ids may require an additional redaction pass.

2) For the privileged access review: would a summary CSV showing role, account owner, last review date, and changes over the last 90 days be sufficient, or do you need the supporting attestation emails as well?

Delivery plan I'm proposing: 
- SOC 2 Type II public report (PDF, redacted) — by 2025-11-12
- Auth log slice (CSV, redacted) + retention commentary — by 2025-11-17
- Privileged access review summary (CSV) — by 2025-11-17

Marcus and Aditya are looped to help extract logs and the privileged review. Marcus: can you confirm we can produce the 30-day auth slice with source IP + MFA outcome, and whether device id is available without heavy manual work? Aditya: can you prepare the privileged review export and indicate whether attestation emails are searchable for the requested date range?

If Novus requires an executed NDA or a secured file transfer method (SFTP or encrypted Drive link), we can use our secure transfer — let us know preference.

Best,
Irene
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II confirmation + targeted artifacts (auth controls)

Irene / Aditya —

Quick technical note based on our logging pipeline: we can produce a CSV slice that includes the following fields out-of-the-box: timestamp, user_id (anonymized), event_type (login, mfa_challenge, mfa_success, mfa_fail), source_ip, user_agent. We do capture device fingerprint in the application telemetry, but it is transient and not stored in the same index; extracting it for a month-range will require a secondary query and ~1-2 business days of engineering time.

Recommendation: provide Novus with source_ip + event outcome first (this covers MFA enforcement checks). If they require device-level identifiers, flag it and we'll schedule the extra extraction (I estimate completion 2025-11-19 if greenlit).

Also, retention: auth logs are retained in the hot index for 90 days and in cold storage for 12 months; extracts will include the fields above and metadata indicating retention tier. I'll draft a short retention summary doc to include with the export.

Irene — I'll start the CSV export for 10/01–10/31 and push to a secure Drive link.

-Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novushealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novushealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 15:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II confirmation + targeted artifacts (auth controls)

Thanks Irene and Marcus — that sounds good. Novus is fine to start with source_ip + MFA outcome. Device identifiers aren't required for our initial intake; we'll surface follow-ups if we need them for deeper forensics.

Can you confirm the secure transfer method? We prefer an encrypted Drive link (Docs with restricted sharing) or an SFTP drop with a one-time password. Once we have the exports, we'll validate redaction and open any narrow follow-ups. Target intake date of 2025-11-20 still works on our side.

Thanks,
Elena
